scope: 20 fixed synthetic pages of256 candidates per mode/backend; no K4/K5 search; end-to-end includes process startup and shutdown. OS/file caches are not cleared; modes run in declared order.

score_sensitivity.interpretation: Conditional sensitivity only. Scores with different masks are not like-for-like likelihood evidence. Zero surviving windows means unavailable, not a score of zero. Marginal compatibility does not replace joint candidate replay.

first_candidate.technique: Exact crib-constrained affine family; deterministic mixed-radix page; frozen crib-masked ngram ranking; CPU literal recipe replay.
